mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ()
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE p.id IN ()

SELECT f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, f.id AS visitId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.fzjc FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN () AND f.research_type IN () AND f.fzjc LIKE '%cfydb%' AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) <= NOW() ORDER BY COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT f.id AS visitId, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, p.name, p.study_no AS studyNo, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_follow_up_history g WHERE g.patient_basic_info_id = f.patient_basic_info_id AND g.research_type IN () AND (COALESCE(g.follow_up_date, g.followUpDate) < COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) OR (COALESCE(g.follow_up_date, g.followUpDate) = COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) AND g.id <= f.id))) AS seq FROM patient_follow_up_history f JOIN patient_basic_info p ON p.id = f.patient_basic_info_id WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN () AND f.research_type IN () AND COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) <= NOW() ORDER BY COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
